boundaries: The non-paced one-packet aggregate push API and the protected server retain their separate send contracts.
Aggregate push still sends the pushed response before the parent body, preserving the existing push-first reader expectation.
A peer push cancellation still completes the parent response before returning RequestCancelled.
feature: Aggregate HTTP/3 server push timeout retires only its streams

regression.deadline: The original awake-clock deadline is not renewed by packet or flow-control progress.
regression.sibling_after_timeout: A later request on the same connection receives 204.
regression.timeout_phase: Push DATA after the parent and push heads are visible
